title: Burger King Employee Attacks Customer Over Food Complaint
description:
A Burger King employee was arrested after allegedly attacking a customer over a food complaint in Lake County, Florida. Police took Miguel Garcia, 25, into custody after he allegedly punched a customer in the face who requested a refund over an alleged wrong order. Miguel, the customer, and other witnesses give their accounts of what allegedly happened in this dramatic encounter. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
